section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations of a single study examining body appreciation and related variables. The study involved first-year college women who were predominantly White and middle-class, with BMI assessed through self-reported height and weight. The authors acknowledge the homogeneity of their sample and recommend future research should examine the model in more diverse populations including men, and suggest longitudinal designs to establish causal relationships.
